info.description: Run folder '0. Seed (run once)' with the Collection Runner to load Step 0 data. Other folders hold CRUD requests; run 'Get all' first to fill the id variable.

exec: data.forEach(x => { const v = map[x.name]; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set(v, x.id); });
data.forEach(x => { const v = map[x.tableNumber]; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set(v, x.id); });
data.forEach(x => { const v = map[x.lastName]; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set(v, x.id); });
data.forEach(x => { const v = map[x.phone]; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set(v, x.id); });
